# The Blue Ocean — Explora Journeys Private Cruise Concierge

> Private selection of Explora Journeys luxury ocean cruises for Ukrainian-speaking guests. All-inclusive. Personal support in 4 languages.

## About

The Blue Ocean is a private cruise curation service specialising in Explora Journeys ocean voyages. We help Ukrainian, English, Russian and Polish-speaking guests choose, plan and book luxury cruises tailored to their preferences — routes, suite type, season and onboard experience.

## What We Offer

- Personalised Explora Journeys cruise selection across Mediterranean, Caribbean, Atlantic and worldwide routes
- Suite type advisory: Ocean Terrace Suite, Penthouse, Residence, Owner's Residence
- Fully all-inclusive experience: 9 signature restaurants, premium beverages, champagne, spa & wellness, unlimited Wi-Fi, gratuities — no hidden charges
- Private consultation and booking support via Telegram
- Support in 4 languages: Ukrainian, English, Russian, Polish

## Suite Types

### Ocean Terrace Suite
Private ocean terrace with direct sea access, floor-to-ceiling windows, king bed, marble bathroom. Ideal for couples seeking intimacy with the sea.

### Penthouse Suite
Spacious luxury penthouse with panoramic ocean views, separate living area, butler service. For guests who want expansive space and exclusivity.

### Residence Suite
Premium multi-room residence with separate bedroom and living room, wraparound terrace, premium amenities. For longer voyages and families.

### Owner's Residence
The most prestigious suite onboard — the ultimate expression of ocean living. Private terrace, separate living and dining areas, personal concierge.

## Dining (9 Signature Restaurants)

- **Sakura** — Asian cuisine with ocean views and tasting menus
- **Emporium Marketplace** — All-day international dining with open kitchen
- **Marble & Co Grill** — Premium steaks and grills, intimate atmosphere
- **Med Yacht Club** — Mediterranean seafood with nautical interiors
- **Fil Rouge** — French-inspired fine dining
- **Anthology** — Curated global cuisine
- And more specialty venues onboard

All dining is included in the cruise fare — no surcharges.

## Included in Every Cruise

- All meals at 9 restaurants
- Premium beverages and champagne throughout
- Ocean Wellness spa treatments
- Unlimited Wi-Fi
- Gratuities
- Private concierge consultation (via The Blue Ocean)

- Atlantic crossings
- Northern Europe (Norway, Iceland, UK)
- Asia, Middle East, Americas — worldwide itineraries
